title: Deep learning with haplotypes maps functional non-coding variants in individual genomes
summary: Whole-chromosome haplotypes, allele-specific regulation data and deep-learning predictions were combined to map non-coding variant effects in their allelic context. The study reports hundreds of cell-type-specific transcription factor binding events disrupted by variants, validated experimentally, and a rare variant that disrupts an OCT2 site in a distal enhancer and modulates PIK3R5 expression.
ai_technology: Deep-learning prediction of transcription factor binding disruption by variants in haplotype context

evidence.tested: Experimental validation of disrupted binding events and the OCT2 site variant.
evidence.unknown: Number of individual genomes and validation rate not stated in the abstract; abstract only; full text not reviewed.
